why_not_pass: The contract is defined and its rules are tested, but no application has adopted it and nobody other than its author has reviewed it. The two positive fixtures are illustrative documents written to exercise the rules; they are not declarations by those applications and not audit results.

negative_fixtures_rejected_for_stated_re.note: Each is a patch on a clean base, so the patch is the only cause. 35 trip exactly the targeted rule; 4 also trip a namespace rule that the same change necessarily violates.

unknown_field_handling.rule: rejected everywhere except x-* extension fields

null_handling.rule: accepted only where a property declares it

deterministic_serialization.rule: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, array order preserved, NaN refused

python_3_9.note: The hub supports Python 3.9. The suite was run locally on 3.13 only; CI runs 3.9 to 3.12.

ws_d_coverage.pinned_and_recent_groups: federation-navigation.schema.json groups[].kind with max_items, overflow and setting_id
ws_d_coverage.per_user_pins_and_recents: federation-settings.schema.json id-list at APPLICATION_USER scope, enforced by nav-setting-scope
ws_d_coverage.rename: federation-actions.schema.json kind=rename requires object_class user-named; rename-not-declared ties it to evidence.renameable_object_types
